checks.detail: W479-P0 contract has no internal violations
post kit exposes the approved universal destination catalogue
a selected destination is a local label and Any app remains available
native sharing needs an explicit user click
a selected image/video is only considered for the one explicit device-share attempt
saved packs never contain media bodies, credentials or hidden persistence
no hosting, proxying, OAuth, direct posting, tracking or network transport is added
the product does not create referral or public links automatically
exported post kit stays metadata/text only and contains no remote-post state
source truth does not mistake a share sheet for a post receipt

limitations: A browser/device share sheet is not proof that a platform posted, accepted, viewed or distributed content.
Platform-specific direct publishing remains a separate W481 connector programme with official approval and real-account evidence.
